qa_pairs.question: What must be removed before pressing off the reverse gear according to the important note?
qa_pairs.answer: Circlip (6) must be removed before pressing off reverse gear.

qa_pairs.question: What should always be replaced during installation?
What special tool is used to press on the guide sleeve?
What must be aligned when pressing on the guide sleeve?
qa_pairs.answer: Make sure that short tabs of synchromesh ring are aligned with groove in pressure pieces when pressing on guide sleeve.

qa_pairs.question: In which direction should the sliding sleeve be moved to adjust the guide sleeve?
qa_pairs.answer: Move sliding sleeve in reverse gear direction.

qa_pairs.question: What component should be adjusted with circlip (6) to take up all play?
qa_pairs.answer: Adjust guide sleeve with circlip (6) to take up all play.

qa_pairs.question: What are available from Parts in different thicknesses?
qa_pairs.answer: Circlips are available from Parts in different thicknesses.

qa_pairs.question: What type of synchromesh ring is used only for version with reverse gear synchronization?
What components should be installed with narrow collar facing reverse gear?
qa_pairs.answer: Install guide and sliding sleeve with narrow collar facing reverse gear.

qa_pairs.question: To what temperature should the thrust washer (7) be heated?
qa_pairs.answer: Heat thrust washer (7) to approx. 80° C.

qa_pairs.question: What should be installed next to the collar according to the assembly instructions?
qa_pairs.answer: Install output shaft next to collar.

qa_pairs.question: What type of bearing should be removed only for version with reverse gear synchronization?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove needle bearing. Only for version with reverse gear synchronization.
